title: Swiss catalog entry
description: One model, and the variants it can be served as. A variant is a hardware-and-parallelism decision, not a deploy: it carries only what the model needs to run at all. Anything site-specific (namespace, host paths, registry mirrors, route ConfigMaps) or per-deploy (replicas, scaling, scheduling, routing) is rejected here by design -- this file is public, and those values are neither public nor the same for two readers.

name.description: Catalog id. Unique across the catalog, and the default served-model name.

servedName.description: What the engine advertises as the model name (--served-model-name), when it should differ from `name`. Renders to model.name. Defaults to `name`.

family.description: Grouping key for the UI (glm, qwen, kimi, ...). Cosmetic.

deprecated.description: Hidden from the marketplace by default; existing deploys still resolve. A string is shown as the reason.

source.description: Model identity, never a location. The chart mounts weights from model.localPath on the host, which is a fact about a cluster -- the site profile derives that path from `hf`, and preflight checks it exists.

revision.description: Commit sha or tag. Pin it when the repo's main branch moves.

sizeGiB.description: On-disk size of the weights. Feeds the site's disk preflight; not a chart value.

requiredGlobs.description: Globs that must match directly under the mounted model directory. Renders to modelCheck.requiredGlobs. Defaults to [config.json].

id.description: Unique within this entry. Convention: <engine>-<parallelism>-<hardware>, e.g. sglang-tp8-b300.

default.description: Preselect this variant in the UI. At most one per entry; the first variant wins if none is marked.

chart.description: Chart name and version only. Never a repository -- the site profile maps the name to its own registry, because this file cannot know it.

image.description: Canonical upstream engine image. The site profile rewrites the repository to its mirror; the tag is carried through as-is.

requires.description: What this variant needs to schedule at all. Preflight checks these against real nodes; the compose step renders `gpus` into model.gpus, so that key is not settable in `values`.

gpus.description: GPUs per pod. For a multi-node variant this is per pod, not per group -- total is gpus x nodes.

nodes.description: Pods per group. 1, or absent, for single-node. Must equal lws.size when lws is enabled.

gpuProduct.description: Acceptable nvidia.com/gpu.product values (GFD labels). Any one matches. Absent means any GPU.

rdma.description: Needs an RDMA device from the shared-device plugin. Implied by topology lws, but stated where it matters.

variantValues.description: Chart values this variant sets. Closed on purpose: only keys the MODEL owns are listed. A key missing here is not an oversight -- it belongs to the site profile or to the deploy form, and setting it in a public catalog would be wrong for every reader. Keys with a second spelling elsewhere in this file (image, model.name, model.gpus) are rejected rather than allowed to drift, the same way the charts refuse a second spelling of nvidia.com/gpu.

model.description: model.name comes from servedName, model.gpus from requires.gpus, and model.localPath from the site profile. None of the three is settable here.

extraArgs.description: Engine flags, appended verbatim. The charts already emit --model-path, --served-model-name, --host, --port and --enable-metrics; do not repeat those.

env.description: Forwarded to Kubernetes verbatim; left open, as in the charts.

resources.description: Extended resources such as rdma/hca_shared. nvidia.com/gpu is rendered from requires.gpus and is rejected here.

lws.description: Multi-node group shape. lws.replicas is the scaler's or the deploy form's, not the model's.

probe.description: Cold-load time is a property of the model, which is why probes live in the catalog. failureThreshold x periodSeconds must cover the worst cold start on the slowest listed GPU -- a 40-minute load behind a default threshold of 3 is killed after 45 seconds, with no error anywhere.
